messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: fixed indexing and transposition operators
parts:
I fixed the parser for the model language so it now
handles mixtures of indexing and transposition properly
(and thus matches the doc!).

That is, if m is a matrix, then m[1] is a row
vector, m'[1] is a row vector, and m[1]' is
a vector.

This means we can write the following model:

data {
int<lower=1> N;
int<lower=1> K;
matrix[N,K] y;
}
parameters {
vector[K] mu;
cov_matrix[K] Sigma;
}
model {
for (n in 1:N)
y[n]' ~ multi_normal(mu,Sigma);
}

Two improvements are still to come.

1. We'll generalize multi_normal_log to allow row vectors
as variates, so the model will reduce to:

for (n in 1:N)
y[n] ~ multi_normal(mu,Sigma);

2. When we vectorize multi_normal_log, the model body
will reduce to:

y ~ multi_normal(mu,Sigma);

- Bob
